CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 32

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 20

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 31

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

9. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 10
   C. 50
   D. 11

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

13. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 13

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 41

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

21. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 20
   D. 75

24. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
